name: Finsupp.mem_span_setOf_iff_exists_linearCombination
statement:
lemma mem_span_setOf_iff_exists_linearCombination {p : M → Prop} {x : M} :
    x ∈ span R {a | p a} ↔ ∃ l : {a // p a} →₀ R, linearCombination R (↑) l = x

name: Bialgebra.IsDiagonalisable.ofBialgEquiv
statement:
lemma IsDiagonalisable.ofBialgEquiv {B : Type*} [Semiring B] [Bialgebra R B]
    [hA : IsDiagonalisable R A] (e : A ≃ₐc[R] B) : IsDiagonalisable R B

name: Bialgebra.IsDiagonalisable.of_span_isGroupLikeElem_eq_top
statement:
lemma IsDiagonalisable.of_span_isGroupLikeElem_eq_top
    (h : Submodule.span R {a : A | IsGroupLikeElem R a} = ⊤) : IsDiagonalisable R A where
  existsIso

name: Bialgebra.isDiagonalisable_iff_span_isGroupLikeElem_eq_top
statement:
lemma isDiagonalisable_iff_span_isGroupLikeElem_eq_top :
    IsDiagonalisable R A ↔ Submodule.span R {a : A | IsGroupLikeElem R a} = ⊤

name: Bialgebra.liftGroupLikeBialgHom_bijective_of_span_isGroupLikeElem_eq_top
statement:
lemma liftGroupLikeBialgHom_bijective_of_span_isGroupLikeElem_eq_top
    (h : Submodule.span R {a : A | IsGroupLikeElem R a} = ⊤) :
    Bijective (liftGroupLikeBialgHom (R := R) (A := A))

name: Bialgebra.span_isGroupLikeElem_eq_top_of_isDiagonalisable
statement:
lemma span_isGroupLikeElem_eq_top_of_isDiagonalisable :
    IsDiagonalisable R A → Submodule.span R {a : A | IsGroupLikeElem R a} = ⊤

name: AlgHom.toUnder_right'
statement: @[simp] lemma toUnder_right' (f : A →ₐ[R] B) : f.toUnder.right = ofHom (f : A →+* B)

name: Polynomial.aevalAEval_X
statement: @[simp] lemma aevalAEval_X (x y : A) : aevalAEval (R := R) x y X = x

name: Polynomial.aevalAEval_Y
statement: @[simp] lemma aevalAEval_Y (x y : A) : aevalAEval (R := R) x y Y = y
